name: k8s[staging] pods are non-root, read-only rootfs, no privilege escalation, all caps dropped
k8s[staging] every container has requests and a memory limit
k8s[staging] images are pinned (tag or digest, never :latest)
k8s[staging] every Deployment container has liveness and readiness probes
k8s[staging] every Deployment is covered by a PodDisruptionBudget
k8s[staging] no Secret object with data is committed in the manifests
k8s[production] pods are non-root, read-only rootfs, no privilege escalation, all caps dropped
k8s[production] every container has requests and a memory limit
k8s[production] images are pinned (tag or digest, never :latest)
k8s[production] every Deployment container has liveness and readiness probes
k8s[production] every Deployment is covered by a PodDisruptionBudget
k8s[production] no Secret object with data is committed in the manifests
docker: non-root final user and pinned base images
migrations: single head, every revision has a real downgrade
observability: every alert links to a runbook heading that exists
secrets: ignore rules present, no .env file in the tree
detail: gitleaks is a separate CI gate

name: open risks: unmeasured / never-executed markers across docs
